message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have the capability to query external services like VirusTotal from here. If you’d like to pull the latest report yourself, you can use the VirusTotal Public API (or their paid endpoint) with your key:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     --header "x-apikey: MS_key321" \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/microsoft.com
```

Replace `MS_key321` with your actual API key. This will return JSON containing all available data about the domain—scan results, reputation scores, associated URLs, etc. Let me know if you need help interpreting the response!
